purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for one governed B02-D withdrawal of a current Schedule placement; it retains the exact prior MaterialStateRef and records real current absence without deleting Activity, Schedule, MaterialState, or history.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scope owning the unschedule receipt.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Client/application identity for idempotent unschedule replay.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Deterministic fingerprint of ScheduleRef and exact expected current state.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Schedule whose current placement was withdrawn.
columns.value_contract: References the retained Schedule; unschedule never deletes it.

columns.name: expected_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Exact placement MaterialStateRef that was current when absence was accepted.
columns.value_contract: References the retained schedule_placement_state and the closed history episode.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative instant at which the open history episode was closed and currentness removed.
columns.value_contract: Recorded inside the bounded database capability.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_unschedule_operation
primary_key.reason: One immutable receipt per self-scoped operation identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind operation scope to the self Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_operation_schedule_ref_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Many chronological withdrawals may target the same retained Schedule.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_op_expected_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain the exact placement state withdrawn by this operation.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_unschedule_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Keep operation identity canonical and bounded.

indexes.name: ix_schedule_unschedule_operation_schedule_ref
indexes.reason: Operational inspection of unschedule receipts per retained Schedule.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates no MaterialState; the prior placement state remains immutable and retained.
state_history.current_binding: Acceptance requires the exact expected MaterialStateRef, then deletes only the schedule.placement current binding.
state_history.chronology: created_at equals the current_until_at that closes the prior open placement-history episode.
state_history.immutability_policy: Receipt replay is immutable; the same operation with different intent conflicts.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: No direct runtime table privileges; downgrade fails closed while unschedule receipts exist.

obligations: runtime has no direct table read/write privilege
same operation id and exact intent replay the immutable withdrawal
same operation id with different intent conflicts
stale expected MaterialStateRef cannot withdraw newer current truth
Activity, Schedule, prior MaterialState and closed history survive while explicit currentness is absent
